# Brief: InvoiceLingo

## Product
Invoicing for freelance translators: per-word rates, multi-currency invoices.

## Audience & initial segment
Freelance translators in Poland invoicing foreign clients.

## Revenue model
29 PLN/month subscription after a 14-day trial.

## Register
| ID | Type | Statement | Source | Evidence level | Status | Date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-1 | F | 12 people signed up to the waitlist from a post in a translators' forum | waitlist export, 2026-09-30 | behavior | open | 2026-09-30 |
| A-1 | A | Trial users convert to paid at ≥ 10% | test: first 50 trials | — | open | 2026-09-30 |
